title: Breaking Diffusion: Parallel Reasoning with Draft Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2610.26542v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Drafting an answer allows a reasoning model to reconsider each decision in the context of the others. Yet repeated diffusion denoising does not ensure that individually plausible token updates form a better answer together. We introduce Draft Refinement Language Models (DRLMs), which use a single denoiser to propose parallel revisions and evaluate a candidate draft. We train the denoiser to reconstruct every token from uniformly corrupted drafts, teaching both preservation and repair. Its predictions specify revisions directly, without a diffusion reverse transition. Evaluation requires a different use of these predictions: confidence in an existing token reflects both contextual support and evidence from observing the token itself. Using the known corruption process, we correct for this self-token evidence to estimate how well each token is supported by the prompt and the remaining draft. Aggregating these estimates yields a cavity en

translated_title: 突破扩散：基于草稿精炼的并行推理
translated_abstract: 草拟答案使推理模型能够在其他决策的背景下重新审视每个决策。然而，反复的扩散去噪并不能确保各个单独看似合理的token更新共同形成一个更好的答案。我们提出了草稿精炼语言模型（DRLMs），它使用单个去噪器来提出并行修订并评估候选草稿。我们训练该去噪器从均匀损坏的草稿中重建每个token，同时教会它保留和修复。其预测直接指定修订内容，而无需扩散反向转移过程。评估则需要以另一种方式使用这些预测：对已有token的置信度既反映了上下文支持，也包含了观察该token本身所得的证据。利用已知的损坏过程，我们校正这种自身token证据，以估计每个token在多大程度上受到提示和其余草稿的支持。汇总这些估计可得到一个空腔熵……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出草稿精炼语言模型（DRLMs），利用单个去噪器并行提出并评估草稿修订，并通过校正自身token证据来衡量token所获得的上下文支持，从而突破传统扩散模型迭代去噪无法保证整体答案变优的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Draft Refinement Language Models (DRLMs), which use a single denoiser to propose and evaluate parallel draft revisions and correct for self-token evidence to estimate contextual support, breaking away from the limitation that iterative diffusion denoising cannot guarantee collectively better answers.
